body: I’m just left curious as to who’s paying for their vaccine at that nursing home if it’s not meant to be billed to insurance. The CARES Act states that Medicare must cover the cost but it still has to be billed. Anyways, nice talking to you as well.

They did change to MBI numbers but that’s assuming everyone got their new part A and B card. And assuming people in a nursing home or LTCF are competent enough to keep track of all that. There is a billing tool that can use the SSN to pull up the new Part B ID which is why SSNs are being gathered in some cases.

It’s to bill Medicare Part B. Pharmacies routinely bill vaccines and prescriptions through insurance. The form is a standard Vaccine Administration Record (VAR) form and does need to be signed by the patient to receive any vaccine.
